title: docs(deployment): keep the developer half (build the artifact, extend the image, CI publish, tenancy, seed repair) and hand production operation of ObjectOS Community to docs.objectos.ai's merged self-managed handbook
body:
Filing gate: ③ a task the maintainer directed — Sam, objectos project thread "Decide docs.objectos.ai content scope", 2026-10-27, verbatim: 「Enterprise 镜像部署；Community 生产自托管部署，是用 docker 吗？有什么区别吗？很多都应该合并吧」 · 「同意，立卡」.

## 维护者速读

ObjectOS Community（`ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/objectstack`）和 Enterprise（`objectos-ee`）是同一个运行时、同一套配置，自托管运维今天在两站各写一份：本仓 `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`（5,129 词）等页写 Community，docs.objectos.ai 的 Deploy/Operate 写 Enterprise。维护者决定合并到 docs.objectos.ai，作为两版本共用的自托管手册（objectstack-ai/docs.objectos.ai#345）。本仓保留开发者半边：怎么 `os build` 出 artifact、扩展官方镜像、CI 里发布、租户模式、种子修复、publish & preview、Cloud Connection 的服务端；生产运行（Compose、K8s、反向代理、备份、升级、观测、排障）指向 docs.objectos.ai。

## Governing text

- Brand split (cloud ADR-0085; this repository's `LICENSING.md`): ObjectStack = the developer brand, objectstack.ai/docs = protocol, SDK, CLI, kernel; ObjectOS Community is the runtime's product name and docs.objectos.ai is the product site for all three editions.
- `AGENTS.md` 〈Documentation Guardrails〉: `content/docs/deployment/` is hand-written; `references/` and `releases/` are untouched by this card.
- `docker/README.md` already says "the full walkthrough lives in Self-Hosted Deployment"; after this card that sentence points at the product site for production and keeps the extend-the-image walkthrough here.

## Done looks like

1. `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` keeps: the artifact model, "extend the official image" Dockerfile, artifact-pinned boot (`OS_ARTIFACT_URL`), first-boot admin bootstrap and sign-up postures (framework-decided behaviour). It drops, with a one-line pointer each to docs.objectos.ai: Docker Compose with Postgres, Kubernetes, bare Node.js systemd, reverse proxy & TLS, scaling, go-live checklist.
2. `deployment/backup-restore.mdx`, `troubleshooting.mdx`, `production-readiness.mdx`: keep what only the framework decides (what `os` commands exist, exit codes, error catalog cross-links); operator runbook content moves to docs.objectos.ai (#345) and is linked.
3. `deployment/index.mdx`'s two-clock table gains a third row: "Where the operator handbook is: docs.objectos.ai/docs/deploy (Community and Enterprise, one handbook)".
4. `docker/README.md` and `content/docs/deployment/meta.json` updated; `lychee.toml` link check green on the new cross-site links.
5. Dispatched **after** objectstack-ai/docs.objectos.ai#345 lands, so no production topic is undocumented in between.

## Out of scope

`deployment/cloud-connection.mdx` (stays: it is the server half, docs.objectos.ai writes the account half), `tenancy-modes`, `seed-tenancy-repair`, `publish-and-preview`, `install-modes`, `app-dependencies`, `validating-metadata`, `cli`, `environment-variables` — all developer-side, unchanged.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/docs.objectos.ai#345
